name: scenario_NetworkReceive_two_boards
description: Two boards: the sender board sends with Network Send, this device receives with Network Receive, each running only what the scenario builds. It sweeps grid size, identity against serpentine layout, mapped by the receiver against the sender, and one layer against two at 40 frames a second; then, with the sender uncapped, the grid from 64x64 to 256x256 in DDP, Art-Net and E1.31; then the preview off, unwatched and watched. Each step reads both cards' status: frames, packets and lost packets a second, sent against received.

steps.description: The sender's canvas: one grid, one layer with a changing effect, and a Network Send aimed at the receiver.

steps.name: receiver-clear-layouts
steps.description: The receiver's canvas: one grid and one layer holding Network Receive; its own drivers stay, so the forward mapping is the real one.
